findings.current: The young man recognized the familiar face and the canned drink in his hand, then muttered in a dubious tone.
findings.defect: The pronoun makes it ambiguous whose hand holds the drink, while the source places it in the approaching middle-aged man's hand.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly has the young man examine the canned drink being held out to him before he accepts it.
findings.replacement: The young man recognized the familiar face and eyed the can in the middle-aged man’s hand, then muttered dubiously.
findings.source: 익숙한 얼굴과 손에 들린 캔 음료를 확인한 청년이 떨떠름한 목소리로 중얼거렸다.

findings.current: The four thousand Hunters who had come here with Minister of National Defense Wei Fenghu had been divided according to their units and sent to search the small cities.
findings.defect: The draft changes the search area from one small city to multiple small cities.
findings.rationale: The source uses 소도시 as the single city being searched at the current battlefield.
findings.replacement: The four thousand Hunters who had come here with Minister of National Defense Wei Fenghu had been divided according to their units and sent to search the small city.
findings.source: 국방부장 웨이펑후를 따라 이곳에 온 4천 명의 헌터들은 편제에 따라 나뉘어 소도시를 수색했다.

findings.current: “Yes, that person. That person was there too.”
findings.defect: The repeated wording erases the speaker's deliberate self-correction from an ordinary reference to a reverential one, and “was there” weakens the enumeration of living survivors into mere battlefield presence.
findings.rationale: The correction from 그 사람 to 그분 marks the middle-aged man's awe, while 계시지 refers to Jin being among the three survivors under discussion.
findings.replacement: “Yes, that man. No—that person survived too.”

findings.current: The middle-aged man could not get the words out, as if his speech had frozen.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the source's explicit modern buffering joke with a generic description.
findings.rationale: 버퍼링이라도 걸린 사람처럼 specifically compares his broken speech to a person buffering, sustaining the scene's technological comedy.
findings.replacement: The middle-aged man stuttered like he’d started buffering.
findings.source: 중년인은 버퍼링이라도 걸린 사람처럼 말을 잇지 못했다.

findings.current: That was when a voice came from behind him.
findings.defect: The draft adds an unsupported location for the voice and omits the middle-aged man's head shake and the fact that he has just risen.
findings.rationale: The source preserves his dismissive head shake and physical movement but does not state that Jin's voice comes from behind him.
findings.replacement: The middle-aged man shook his head and rose from his seat. At that moment, a voice spoke up.
findings.source: 절레절레 고개를 저은 중년인이 자리에서 일어난 그 순간이었다.

findings.current: “You there, young man—stop hiccupping if you don’t want to become a good Chinese person. And you, sir, stop shaking. Unless you’re planning to bring down the Arch Lich with a great earthquake.”
findings.defect: “Stop shaking” replaces Jin's direct command to stop the “earthquake,” weakening the joke prompted by the man's repeated Ji-Ji-Jin stutter.
findings.rationale: The source repeats 지진 and 대지진, making the earthquake image itself the punchline rather than merely describing the man's trembling.
findings.replacement: “You there, young man—stop hiccupping if you don’t want to become a good Chinese person. And you, sir, stop the earthquake—unless you’re planning to use a great one to bring down the Arch Lich.”
findings.source: “거기 젊은 분은 착한 중국인 되기 싫으면 딸꾹질 멈추시고. 아저씨는 지진을 멈춰 주세요. 대지진으로 아크 리치 쓰러트릴 생각 아니시면.”

findings.current:
“Yes, sir!”

The young man answered like he was screaming and hurried over. A mana-infused blow drew a genuine scream from him.
findings.defect: The generic “blow” omits the specific joint-targeting strike expressed by the colloquial 조인트.
findings.rationale: 조인트 in this context is a colloquial shin kick, so the source specifies both the physical action and the target rather than an unspecified hit.
findings.replacement:
“Y-Yes, sir!”

The young man answered with a shriek and darted over, only to let out a real scream when a mana-infused kick struck his shin.
findings.source:
「예, 옛!」

비명처럼 대답한 청년은 잽싸게 달려갔고, 마나가 실린 조인트에 진짜 비명을 내질렀다.

findings.current: At long last, it was time to defeat the culprit behind all of this.
findings.defect: “Defeat” weakens the intended final disposition of the culprit from eliminating or dispatching it to merely overcoming it.
findings.rationale: 처치해야 indicates that the source of the catastrophe must be disposed of, matching Jin's declaration that they are going to end the war.
findings.replacement: At long last, it was time to eliminate the culprit behind all of this.
findings.source: 바야흐로, 이 모든 일의 원흉을 처치해야 할 때였다.

summary: Several localized fidelity issues alter location scope, hierarchy, physical action, humor, and the final intended consequence.
